arxiv-2108-04327.title: Natural Numerical Networks for Natura 2000 habitats classification by satellite images
arxiv-2108-04327.creator: Karol Mikula, Michal Kollár, Aneta A. Ožvat, Martin Ambroz, Lucia Čahojová, Ivan Jarolímek, Jozef Šibík, Mária Šibíková
arxiv-2108-04327.description: Abstract Natural numerical networks are introduced as a new classification algorithm based on the numerical solution of nonlinear partial differential equations of forward-backward diffusion type on complete graphs. The proposed natural numerical network is applied to open important environmental and nature conservation task, the automated identification of protected habitats by using satellite images.

arxiv-2302-06448.title: Joint Span Segmentation and Rhetorical Role Labeling with Data Augmentation for Legal Documents
arxiv-2302-06448.creator: Santosh T.Y.S.S, Philipp Bock, Matthias Grabmair
arxiv-2302-06448.description: Abstract Segmentation and Rhetorical Role Labeling of legal judgements play a crucial role in retrieval and adjacent tasks, including case summarization, semantic search, argument mining etc. Previous approaches have formulated this task either as independent classification or sequence labeling of sentences.

arxiv-2309-13993.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Spencer L. Gordon, Erik Jahn, Bijan Mazaheri, Yuval Rabani, Leonard J. Schulman. We consider the problem of identifying, from statistics, a distribution of discrete random variables X 1 , … , X n X_{1},\ldots,X_{n} that is a mixture of k k product distributions.

arxiv-2404-14451.title: Generative Subspace Adversarial Active Learning for Outlier Detection in Multiple Views of High-dimensional Data
arxiv-2404-14451.creator: Jose Cribeiro-Ramallo, Vadim Arzamasov, Federico Matteucci, Denis Wambold, Klemens Böhm
arxiv-2404-14451.description: Abstract Outlier detection in high-dimensional tabular data is an important task in data mining, essential for many downstream tasks and applications. Existing unsupervised outlier detection algorithms face one or more problems, including inlier assumption (IA), curse of dimensionality (CD), and multiple views (MV).

arxiv-2505-14297.title: Cross-Lingual Optimization for Language Transfer in Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-14297.creator: Jungseob Lee ∗ , Seongtae Hong ∗ , Hyeonseok Moon, Heuiseok Lim † Korea University {omanma1928, ghdchlwls123, glee889, limhseok}@korea.ac.kr
arxiv-2505-14297.description: Abstract † † This paper has been accepted at the ACL 2025 main conference. † † ∗ Equal contribution; † Corresponding author Adapting large language models to other languages typically employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as a standard approach. However, it often suffers from an overemphasis on English performance, a phenomenon that is especially pronounced in data-constrained environments.

arxiv-2512-23581.title: Profile Bayesian Optimization for Expensive Computer Experiments
arxiv-2512-23581.creator: Courtney Kyger, James Fernandez, John A. Grunenwald, James Braun, Annie S. Booth
arxiv-2512-23581.description: Abstract We propose a novel Bayesian optimization (BO) procedure aimed at identifying the “profile optima” of a deterministic black-box computer simulation that has a single control parameter and multiple nuisance parameters. The profile optima capture the optimal response values as a function of the control parameter.

arxiv-2602-19452.title: Dekker’s floating point number system and compensated summation algorithms Thanks: Email address: fabaidoo@utexas.edu
arxiv-2602-19452.creator: Longfei Gao
arxiv-2602-19452.description: Abstract The recent hardware trend towards reduced precision computing has reignited the interest in numerical techniques that can be used to enhance the accuracy of floating point operations beyond what is natively supported for basic arithmetic operations on the hardware.

arxiv-2602-20441.title: An algorithm for Seifert surfaces in 3 3 -manifolds via surgery presentations
arxiv-2602-20441.creator: Geunyoung Kim
arxiv-2602-20441.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Geunyoung Kim. The classical Seifert algorithm provides an explicit construction of a Seifert surface for any link in S 3 S^{3} . Alegria and Menasco extended this construction to integral homology 3 3 -spheres using Heegaard splittings. In this paper, we extend the Seifert algorithm to null-homologous links in arbitrary 3 3 -manifolds via surgery on framed links in S 3 S^{3} .

pmc-11525714.title: Binaural beats at 0.25 Hz shorten the latency to slow-wave sleep during daytime naps
pmc-11525714.creator: Zhiwei Fan, Yunyao Zhu, Chihiro Suzuki, Yoko Suzuki, Yumi Watanabe, Takahiro Watanabe, Takashi Abe
pmc-11525714.description: Binaural beats can entrain neural oscillations and modulate behavioral states. However, the effect of binaural beats, particularly those with slow frequencies (< 1 Hz), on sleep remains poorly understood. We hypothesized that 0.25-Hz beats can entrain neural oscillations and enhance slow-wave sleep by shortening its latency or increasing its duration.

pmc-11531261.title: Identification and validation of autophagy-related genes in Hirschsprung’s disease
pmc-11531261.creator: Ting Yao, Zenghui Hao, Wei Fan, Jinbao Han, Shuyu Wang, Zaiqun Jiang, Yunting Wang, Xiao Qian Yang, Zhilin Xu
pmc-11531261.description: BackgroundHirschsprung’s disease (HSCR) is a congenital disorder characterized by aganglionosis in the intermuscular and submucosal nerve plexuses of the gut, leading to impaired gastrointestinal function. Although the precise cause and pathophysiology of HSCR remain elusive, increasing evidence points to a significant role of autophagy in its development, warranting further investigation into its underlying mechanisms.

pmc-11622905.title: Automatic spread factor and position definition for UAV gateway through computational intelligence approach to maximize signal-to-noise ratio in wooded environments
pmc-11622905.creator: Caio M. M. Cardoso, Alex S. Macedo, Filipe C. Fernandes, Hugo A. O. Cruz, Fabrício J. B. Barros, Jasmine P. L. de Araújo
pmc-11622905.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The emergence of long-range (LoRa) technology, together with the expansion of uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) use in civil applications have brought significant advances to the Internet of Things (IoT) field. In this way, these technologies are used together in different scenarios, especially when it is necessary to have connectivity in remote and difficult-to-access locations, providing coverage and monitoring of greater areas.

pmc-11647838.title: A novel in-silico approach to design a multiepitope peptide as a vaccine candidate for Aeromonashydrophila
pmc-11647838.creator: Mahdieh SobhZahedi, Mohammad Hossein YektaKooshali
pmc-11647838.description: IntroductionAeromonas hydrophila is a Gram-negative bacterium with a rod-shaped structure and a member of the Aeromonas genus. It is commonly found in aquatic environments such as freshwater, estuaries, and sewage. Known as an opportunistic pathogen, A. hydrophila can infect both aquatic animals and humans.

pmc-12007516.title: Combining magnetoencephalography with telemetric streaming of intracranial recordings and deep brain stimulation—A feasibility study
pmc-12007516.creator: Mansoureh Fahimi Hnazaee, Matthias Sure, George C. O’Neill, Gaetano Leogrande, Alfons Schnitzler, Esther Florin, Vladimir Litvak
pmc-12007516.description: The combination of subcortical Local Field Potential (LFP) recordings and stimulation with Magnetoencephalography (MEG) in Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) patients enables the investigation of cortico-subcortical communication patterns and provides insights into DBS mechanisms. Until now, these recordings have been carried out in post-surgical patients with externalised leads.

pmc-12969418.title: Spectrum, prevalence, and clinical correlates of PPM1D mutations in patients with clonal hematopoiesis and clonal cytopenias
pmc-12969418.creator: Talha Badar, Ludovica Marando, Eric Latorre, Terra Lasho, Francyess Denis Olivia, Chenyu Lin, Benjamin J McCormick, Mobachir El Kettani, Kashish J Shah, Yael Kusne, Omer Jamy, Kendall Diebold, Alexander Coltoff, Christy Finke, James Foran, Mohamed Kharfan-Dabaja, Yao-Shan Fan, Liuyan Jiang, Rong He,
pmc-12969418.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Key Points•PPM1D mutations dominate t-CH/t-CCUS, show the shortest latency after genotoxic therapy, and are enriched in this subgroup.•Although the median PPM1D VAF was relatively lower, a higher VAF (≥13%) was linked to inferior overall survival. Introduction

Recent studies examining somatic mutations in blood cells of individuals exposed to cytotoxic therapy have highlighted the selective expansion of hematopoietic stem cells harboring alterations in key DNA damage response (DDR) genes.

pmc-13097350.title: Validity and Reliability Assessment of the Persian Version of a EORTC QLQ‐STO22 Questionnaire for Patients With Gastric Cancer Who Underwent Total Gastrectomy
pmc-13097350.creator: Asma Mousavi, Leyla Sahebi, Seyed Amir Miratashi Yazdi
pmc-13097350.description: Background and AimsThe EORTC QLQ‐STO22 is a widely validated instrument for assessing health‐related quality of life in patients with gastric cancer. Given the high prevalence of gastric cancer and its specific risk factors in Iran, validating this tool for the Iranian population is essential. This study aimed to evaluate the validity and reliability of the Persian‐translated EORTC QLQ‐STO22.

pmc-13380027.title: A Life‐Threatening Case of Fournier's Gangrene
pmc-13380027.creator: Rova Malala Fandresena Randrianarisoa, Scholastique Ngo Souck M, Thileli Amrane, Meroua Bouakrif, Liliane Iribaziga, Cherif Omeiri, Catherine Letrillard
pmc-13380027.description: We report severe Fournier's gangrene in a 69‐year‐old man presenting with septic shock and extensive perineal gas on computed tomography. Enterococcus faecium was identified. Fournier's gangrene may occur without classical risk factors. Early recognition, broad‐spectrum antibiotics, and urgent surgical debridement are essential to improve survival and reduce mortality.
